svg.desc: Top row, lossless: PyTorch model exported to ONNX and run in ONNX Runtime, tested with exact parity. Bottom row, lossy: a LightGBM teacher distilled into a small student and quantised to int8, tested with Spearman correlation, top-k overlap and NDCG.
